name: Prissy Plastique
source:
Prissy Plastique is just about the prettiest plastic plant this side of the electrical closet! She brightens any room she's in with her shiny blooms and her bright and peppy attitude. She'd like to brighten more than none room at a time... but with only one plastic plant that might not be possible.
Likes: Magic, Hope, Tourism 
Dislikes: Realism, Despair, Staying Put

[From the in-game Date-a-dex]
